# SVG.js 3.2.8

Vendored unmodified browser distribution of [`@svgdotjs/svg.js`](https://github.com/svgdotjs/svg.js), MIT license (see LICENSE.txt). No CDN, installation, backend or runtime dependencies are required by atlas visitors.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@svgdotjs/svg.js/-/svg.js-3.2.8.tgz

Verified npm tarball integrity: `sha512-NUdbI/7FDdqGpzKmqr09IQoy9MUcrAC/3bC8gLgXi6OfJuyri450zMLvJekFUhuq3iN5gpdPjoSoStNl9Eijfg==`

`svg.min.js` SHA256: `90fc33bcba8181aa5e96e5c975da19f0912d7097a4ec9056ba130fc3ce328ec6`.

The library draws SVG geometry only. `representation-diagrams.js` supplies the atlas's validated Young row lengths and finite-type Bourbaki Dynkin graph layouts. It is not a representation-theory calculation engine. Node numbering follows the convention linked in the atlas guide. Ordinary Dynkin diagrams are not drawn for Abelian factors, and ordinary Young diagrams are shown only for safely converted A-series representations.
